about: The events of a Mars Genesis pair the hosted demo saved on 11 November 2026 (session 57faa842-6954-401b-830d-a571d35a6c97, completed 09:51 UTC): Aria Chen against Dietrich Voss, 6 turns of 8 years from Year 2035, as GET /sessions/<id>/replay served them. Kept: the events the chat route reads (turn_start, agent_reactions, specialist_done, decision_made, outcome) and each leader's last systems_snapshot, in the order they were sent, each without its cost bookkeeping (_cost); the department reports cut to their turn, time, department and summary, the decisions to their turn, time, text and rationale. Bruno Morales (col-bruno-morales), the Chief Engineer, reacted under both leaders.
